paragraphs.text: God encourages the Prophet to signify the speedy coming of the enemy against Israel, which was once the people of God.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: They will cry like hypocrites, but not from the heart, as their deeds declare.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: That is, Jeroboam, by whom they sought their own liberty, and to obey my will.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: That is, upright judgment and a godly life.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Meaning the calf was invented by themselves, and by their fathers in the wilderness.
paragraphs.label: e
paragraphs.anchor: For from Israel was it also

paragraphs.text: Showing that their religion has but a show, and in itself is but vanity.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: They never cease, but run to and fro to seek help.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: That is, for the king and the princes will lay upon them: and by this means the Lord brings them to repentance.
paragraphs.label: h
paragraphs.anchor: burden of the king of princes

paragraphs.text: In this way the idolaters consider the word of God as strange with regard to their own invention.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: Saying that they offer it to the Lord, but he accepts no service which he himself has not appointed.
paragraphs.label: k
